name: Senhaja de Srair (Berber)

ancestors.notes: Descent from Proto-Berber (Northern Berber, Rif group)
Moroccan Arabic (Darija) adstrate: pharyngeals, emphatics, loan phonology

notes: Skeleton. Senhaja de Srair (a Northern/Rif Berber variety of Morocco), in Berber-Latin notation with pharyngeals ⟨ḥ ɛ⟩, emphatics ⟨ḍ ṣ ṭ ẓ ṛ⟩ and ⟨ǧ⟩=/dʒ/. Strong Moroccan Arabic adstrate. Stress exemption: Senhaja de Srair, like other Northern Berber (Riffian-adjacent) varieties, has stress that is largely predictable from syllable weight but not encoded as a spelling-derivable rule in the source used here. Source: Kossmann, Maarten (2013), A Grammar of Riffian Berber studies, on the Northern Berber stress system.

sources.author: Kossmann, Maarten
sources.title: The Arabic Influence on Northern Berber
